source.note: Prices and scores come from the leaderboard CSV; the ids come from pi's model store, which carries the models this key may route (an OpenRouter guardrail or a provider restriction is already applied there), and the OpenRouter catalogue, the public record of what OpenRouter lists. A tier holds the models whose input price sits under its rung (low 0.1, medium 2, high 4 USD per 1M tokens; the top tier takes the rest), keeping the newest model of each model line in the tier. A group leads with the model its ladder anchor names when the key can route a member of that family, and with the best member of a declared family when it cannot; the rest follow in ascending price; the zero-priced open-weight members come last, because a zero price has no position in the order. A row the leaderboard leaves unpriced is reported under unpriced; a row with no id this key may route is reported under excluded, with its reason.
